name: Telegram Channel Scraper
title: Telegram Channel Scraper: Posts, Views, Reactions, Subscribers
uses: Crypto, news and OSINT researchers monitoring public Telegram channels
Marketers tracking views, reactions and subscriber growth for channels in their niche
Building datasets of channel posts with links, media and forwards
AI agents summarizing what a public Telegram channel posted recently

inputs.name: channels
inputs.title: Channels
inputs.description: Public channel usernames, @handles or t.me links, e.g. durov, @telegram, https://t.me/s/durov

inputs.name: maxPostsPerChannel
inputs.title: Max posts per channel
inputs.description: Newest posts first. Use 0 to fetch only channel info.

inputs.name: postsNewerThan
inputs.title: Only posts newer than
inputs.description: Optional ISO date or datetime (UTC), e.g. 2026-11-01. Stops paging when older posts are reached.

inputs.name: searchQuery
inputs.title: Keyword search inside channel
inputs.description: Optional. Returns only posts matching this keyword (Telegram's own in-channel search).

inputs.name: includeChannelInfo
inputs.title: Include channel info row
inputs.description: Adds one row per channel with title, description, verified flag, subscribers and media counts.

description: Scrape public Telegram channels without login or API keys. Get posts with text, date, views, reactions, links, photos, videos and forwards, plus subscriber counts. Date filter, keyword search, full history paging. $0.0003 per post.
